paragraphs.text: A chain of supermarkets in one country now turns the music and half the lights off for one hour every Tuesday morning. Tills beep more quietly, and staff avoid using the loudspeaker unless it is an emergency.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The idea came from parents of autistic children, for whom a normal shop can be exhausting. Shops that tried the quiet hour reported that older customers and people recovering from illness also came for it.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Sales during the hour are lower than usual, but managers say that the customers who come during it shop more often at other times, and that staff prefer working in the quieter store.
paragraphs.label: C
